Veneers and teeth whitening in Ajmer

Veneers are thin, tooth-coloured shells bonded to the front of teeth to cover stains, chips or small gaps. Whitening lightens your natural tooth colour in a single clinic visit.

From ₹6,000 1 visit for whitening, 2 to 3 for veneers Not covered by schemes, EMI available
Book a consultation Ask on WhatsApp

Is this for me?

You may need this treatment if you have:

  • Stained or discoloured front teeth
  • Small chips or uneven edges
  • Small gaps between front teeth
  • Teeth that look worn

Only an examination, and an X-ray where needed, can confirm it. We have X-rays at the clinic.

What happens

  1. ConsultationWe look at your smile and check the shade.
  2. PlanningFor veneers, we show you a preview of the result.
  3. Preparation or whiteningTeeth are prepared for veneers, or whitened in one session.
  4. Fitting veneersVeneers are bonded and polished.
  5. ReviewWe check the result and your bite.

Comfort and recovery

Whitening can make teeth sensitive for a day or two. Veneers need little or no numbing. Both are done at the clinic.

Veneers and whitening: common questions

Does whitening damage teeth?

Professional whitening is safe for enamel. Temporary sensitivity is common and passes.

What are veneers made of?

Porcelain, ceramic, composite or acrylic resin. Your dentist recommends one based on your teeth and budget.

How long do veneers last?

With good care, porcelain veneers last many years. Composite veneers may need touching up sooner.
